Device_Extension.label: Device Extension
Device_Extension.description: The uCIFI device extension is an extension to the standard Lightweight M2M device (object ID 3) using the resource called "ExtDevInfo" (resource ID 22).

GTIN_model_number.label: GTIN model number
GTIN_model_number.description: Standard global trade-in international number for the control device.

Manufacturer_identifier.label: Manufacturer identifier
Manufacturer_identifier.description: Unique identifier of the manufacturer of the control device, equivalent to IEEE's OUI (Organizational Unique Identifier). This value should be a Hexadecimal value. This value may be used by an online uCIFI product catalog server, for software modules to retrieve the data model of a device using this attribute associated with the model number on the "Device" (Id=3) object.

User-given_name.label: User-given name
User-given_name.description: User-readable name of the device set by the user.

Asset_identifier.label: Asset identifier
Asset_identifier.description: Identifier of the asset (e.g. meter, luminaire, container) that is controlled by the device.

Software_update.label: Software update
Software_update.description: Set to True while software within the device is being updated.

Maintenance.label: Maintenance
Maintenance.description: Set to True when the device is in maintenance mode.

Device_operating_hours.label: Device operating hours
Device_operating_hours.description: Cumulated number of hours during which the device has been powered on.

Additional_firmware_information.label: Additional firmware information
Additional_firmware_information.description: Additional information about peripheral firmware versions. The format is left to the vendor.

DST_Start.label: DST Start
DST_Start.description: The precise date and UTC time during the year when Daylight Saving Time begins, represented as Unix Time.

DST_End.label: DST End
DST_End.description: The precise date and UTC time during the year when Daylight Saving Time ends, represented as Unix Time.

DST_Offset.label: DST Offset
DST_Offset.description: The amount by which the UTC offset changes when Daylight Saving Time is in effect, represented as ISO 8601 time offset format. A DST offset of one hour is represented as "01:00"

Uptime.label: Uptime
Uptime.description: Number of seconds since the last reboot of the device.

RFD_device.label: RFD device
RFD_device.description: Set to true if the device is a Reduce Functional Device running on battery.

Configuration_reset.label: Configuration reset
Configuration_reset.description: Reset the configuration parameters (and only the configuration parameters) of the device. It does not clear any counter (e.g. kWh counter or operating hour counter).
